Get Account Groups Count
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/accountGroups/count

Retrieves the total number of AWS account groups.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
integer
int32

Returns the total number of AWS groups.
